title: Switchyard / Cache
description: Exact and semantic cache: hit ratio and USD saved (spec 009). Panels land with spec 009's metrics.

options.content:
Panels for the cache come with spec 009 (caching), which adds `switchyard_cache_lookups_total{layer,result}`, `switchyard_cache_savings_usd_total`, `switchyard_cache_errors_total` and the `cache` label on `switchyard_requests_total`.

The dashboard check (`pnpm check:grafana`) only lets panels query metrics the code emits, so they are added in the same change as the metrics. See `docs/observability.md`.
